pre_survey.title: Pre-Study Survey
pre_survey.description: Please answer the following questions before starting the coding task. All questions are required.

questions.question: What is your current education level?
How much experience do you have in programming?
questions.help_text: 1 = No experience, 2 = Beginner (< 6 months), 3 = Intermediate (6–24 months), 4 = Advanced (2–4 years), 5 = Expert (4+ years or professional)

questions.question: How frequently do you use AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or other coding agents?
questions.help_text: 1 = Never, 2 = Rarely (once a month or less), 3 = Occasionally (a few times a month), 4 = Frequently (a few times a week), 5 = Very frequently (daily or almost daily)

questions.content: Please answer the following questions with respect to your usage of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot (similar to ChatGPT). Choose N/A if you have no experience with the tool.

image.alt: GitHub Copilot AI coding assistant demonstration

questions.help_text: Choose N/A if you have no experience with the tool

questions.help_text: Choose N/A if you have no experience with the tool

questions.question: I am confident in the system.
questions.help_text: Choose N/A if you have no experience with the tool

questions.question: The system is reliable.

questions.question: Please describe why you trust or distrust AI for use in coding in your own words.
questions.placeholder: Describe the factors that influence your trust or distrust in AI coding assistants...

questions.question: Please describe in your own words, how you think AI Coding Assistants generate code suggestions?
questions.placeholder: Explain your understanding of how AI generates code suggestions...

questions.question: How accurate do you believe AI-generated code suggestions are?
questions.help_text: Move the slider to indicate your perceived accuracy (0% = completely inaccurate, 100% = perfectly accurate)
